$comment: Initial JS per route, gzipped. Checked by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs.
Bolum 52.6: changing a budget must be a visible decision, so these numbers
live in a file a reviewer sees rather than inside a command.
totalKb        - the ceiling from Bolum 52.3. Applies to every route.
sharedKb       - chunks every route loads: the React and Next runtime plus
whatever the root layout pulls in. This should only move
when a dependency is added or upgraded. Measured at 168.1.
perRouteOwnKb  - everything a route loads beyond the shared baseline. This
is the part feature work controls, and the only number a
normal change should ever push against.
Marketing routes currently sit at 0.0 KB of own code: they are server
components with no client JavaScript at all.
